        return

        return
    if step > maxT + 1:
        return
    if visitedStates[step][x][y][xRef][yRef]:

    if timeGrid[x][y] != 0 and step > timeGrid[x][y]:
        return
    if timeGrid[x][y] == step and (mapB[x][y] > '9' or mapB[x][y] <= '0'):
        return

    if step < timeGrid[x][y]:
        runDP(step + 1, x, y, xRef, yRef)
        runDP(step + 1, x + 1, y, xRef, yRef)
        runDP(step + 1, x - 1, y, xRef, yRef)
        runDP(step + 1, x, y + 1, xRef, yRef)
        runDP(step + 1, x, y - 1, xRef, yRef)

for i in range(sizeN):

        if timeGrid[i][j] == -1:
            timeGrid[i][j] = t

for i in range(sizeN):

F = [[0 for _ in range(210)] for _ in range(210)]

for i1 in range(sizeN):
    for j1 in range(sizeN):
        for i2 in range(sizeN):
            for j2 in range(sizeN):

for i1 in range(sizeN):
    for j1 in range(sizeN):
        if mapA[i1][j1] > '0' and mapA[i1][j1] <= '9':

            for i2 in range(sizeN):

                            else:
                                _k = pN[i2][j2]
                            graph[k].append(_k)
                            graph[_k].append(k)
                            C[k][_k] = 10000
                            C[_k][k] = 0

for i2 in range(sizeN):
    for j2 in range(sizeN):
        if mapB[i2][j2] > '0' and mapB[i2][j2] <= '9' and pN[i2][j2] > 0:
            _k = pN[i2][j2]
            graph[_k].append(0)

            C[0][_k] = 0

while True:
    allDone = True
